name: m-power
description: Bootstrap skill for Methodology M projects — automates setup, scaffolding, and delivery of distributed multi-repo systems
author: Methodology M Workshop

capabilities.name: setup-workspace
capabilities.description: Create a new M-type project workspace on GitLab

capabilities.name: bootstrap-root-repo
capabilities.description: Create and seed the root repo for an M-type project

capabilities.name: generate-pats
capabilities.description: Generate story-level PATs from a story file

capabilities.name: decompose-story
capabilities.description: Decompose a story into component-scoped sub-tasks with PAT mapping

capabilities.name: scaffold-repo
capabilities.description: Create and configure a managed repo from a sub-task file

capabilities.name: wire-orchestration
capabilities.description: Connect managed repos to the root repo orchestration layer

capabilities.name: generate-acceptance-tests
capabilities.description: Compile PAT stubs into CATs using the repo-appropriate framework

capabilities.name: tag-release
capabilities.description: Tag a managed repo at a version and update the root repo topology
